6d207c99e4bc7435.desc: It's time for our TeenTober Scary Story contest, and this year we're bringing in some experts to help you out! Lilliam Rivera is an award-winning author of nine works of fiction: a dark thriller, four young adult novels, three middle grade books, and a graphic novel for DC Comics. Her books have been awarded a Pura Belpré Honor, been featured on NPR, New Yorker, Los Angeles Times, NY Times, and multiple “best of” lists. Her writing has appeared in Elle Magazine, The Washington Post, New York Times, to name a few. She is also a screenwriter and has written for the episodic podcast series Love in Gravity, which was nominated for a 2024 GLAAD. We'll also be giving away copies of Lilliam's books to some lucky winners. If you think you've written a scary tour de force, be sure to enter it in the contest. This program is for teens in grades 6-12, registration is not required.

6d934b69daff73c0.title: Eivor
6d934b69daff73c0.desc: Prepare to be enchanted by Eivør, one of the most influential Nordic artists of our time, as she brings her captivating live performance to North America. Hailing from the Faroe Islands, a remote archipelago located in the North Atlantic between Iceland and Norway, Eivør masterfully blends Faroese folk traditions, operatic grandeur, and primal throat singing, creating a sound that is both otherworldly and deeply connected to nature. With an ethereal yet dark Nordic edge, she has drawn comparisons to Kate Bush but carves her own unique path in the world of music. Eivør’s live performances are a once-in-a-lifetime experience, showcasing her unparalleled vocal range and emotive power. Her voice moves effortlessly between ethereal operatic highs and visceral, primal depths, enchanting audiences around the world. Having toured extensively with the Nordic collective Heilung, she continues to redefine what it means to connect the ancient with the modern. Eivør's artistic excellence has earned her numerous accolades, including multiple Faroese Music Awards and the prestigious Nordic Council Music Prize, further solidifying her place as a groundbreaking figure in contemporary Nordic…
